ambient_events: The cargo netting sways in unison as the airframe shifts, a slow green tide.
Tie-down rings sing a low note when the floor flexes under load.
Far overhead, the roof of the hold vanishes into gloom the cabin lights never reach.
description: The cargo hold: a cavern of ribbed aluminium big enough to swallow a house, floored in roller-track and gridded with tie-down rings. Cargo netting hangs in green curtains from the frames, and the ceiling climbs away into a dark the cabin lights never quite reach. Whatever the Leviathan is really for, it's for this. The galley lies forward to the NORTH.
name: Cargo Hold
